description.en: OncoTriad-QA is a patient-level benchmark for pan-cancer question answering, integrating radiology, pathology, genomics, and clinical metadata from TCGA. It includes 86.1k questions across 9,281 cases and 32 cancer cohorts, with annotations derived from curated labels and diagnostic reports.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing medical LLM benchmarks often focus on isolated modalities. OncoTriad-QA could address the gap in evaluating integrated, patient-level reasoning across multiple evidence types, which is crucial for real-world oncology decision support.
